claims.evidence: combined.zip experimentalDesignTemplate.txt names 8 SILAC experiments A-I (no H) with run names F090801_Dir1_*, F091104_Dir1b_*, F090807_Dir2_*, F090804_Rev1_*, F090925_Rev1b_*, F091127_Dir2b_*, F101215_Dir2_*, F101217_Rev1_* (renamed from the deposited RAW names; mapping by date + OFFGEL well in filemap.tsv; 2010 sets suffixed -Sort3 after the deposited names "..._Sort3_NN" to keep the two "Dir2"/"Rev1" names distinct). Each experiment is one heavy+light SILAC mixture, so one source per (experiment, channel) = one physical labelled cell population. Data in Brief Table 1 lists the same 8 functional experiments (rows 1-8) and two groups of wt:wt runs: rows 9-11 (F090303_..._A, _B, F090401_ev_Bcell_HL1to1 = MaxQuant "Ele") and rows 12-13 (F080904TB_yeast_2567, F080917TB_2567 = MaxQuant "Lele"). Each wt:wt group is encoded as one mixture (WTWT1 = Ele, WTWT2 = Lele) whose heavy and light populations are one source each, measured in three series (technical replicates).

claims.evidence: Data in Brief 2.3: "For the Dir experiments miRNA cells were labeled with heavy medium, and control cells with light medium"; Table 1 marks A-C,F,G as Dir1, Dir1 bis, Dir2, Dir2 bis, Dir2 (Sort3). Paper Fig. 1b legend: "Control and miR-17-19b overexpressing cells (miR cells) were cultured in light (L) and heavy (H) media, respectively"; Supp Fig 2b legend: "light = control; heavy= miR cells". Data check (normalized H/L, mqA proteinGroups) on the Western-blot-confirmed down-regulated targets of Supp Fig 2e: Pbk 0.35/0.26/0.22/0.34/0.34, Ptk2b 0.39/0.34/0.39/0.32/0.15, Htra2 0.39/0.42/0.48/0.42/0.50 in A/B/C/F/G (paper reports Pbk 0.31/0.34, Ptk2b 0.33/0.35, Htra2 0.42/0.50) -> heavy = miR cells. Pairwise Pearson of log2 H/L among A,B,C,F,G all positive (0.35-0.67).

limitations: Biological replicate structure: Data in Brief gives the clone of each mixture (encoded in characteristics[clone]) but does not say whether the "bis" mixtures (Dir1 bis, Dir2 bis, Rev1 bis) were labelled from new cultures or re-prepared from the same lysates. Each of the 8 functional mixtures carries its own number (1-8 per genotype group); if "bis" sets are re-preparations this over-counts independent cultures within clone #1.

WT:WT technical replicates: the three series of each wt:wt mixture are encoded as technical replicates (paper Supp Fig 4a "three technical replicates"; DiB row 13 "in duplicate"). Whether f080904 yeast_2567 and f080917 b/c (WTWT2), or the f090303 A/B and F090401 series (WTWT1), came from one gel lane or separate lanes of the same mixture is not stated.
